14 teams participated in the '''1992–93 Egyptian Premier League season'''. The first team in the league was the champion, and qualified to the [[1994 African Cup of Champions Clubs|African Cup of Champions Clubs]].
[[Zamalek SC|Zamalek]] won the league for the 8th time in the club's history.<ref>[[:ar:الدوري المصري الممتاز 1992–93]]</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://drtareksaid.net/SocDawry9394.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210131195635/http://drtareksaid.net/SocDawry9394.html|url-status=usurped|archive-date=January 31, 2021|title=Dr.Tarek Said's Homepage - Egyptian League 1993/94|website=drtareksaid.net}}</ref>
